ownerReport: FPS much better; brief loading/large-fight/zoom stutter that settles; audio now seems fine; one transient total black screen recovered; repeated black rings around textured dirt remain in the supplied photo. No numerical FPS claim is inferred from the cropped image.
method: Native Chromium with original painted terrain. A controlled probe blanks the cached blend canvases and injects their loss flags. A retained-stale-texture control reproduces holes; the production lookup rebuilds textures before reuse. Synthetic canvas-loss events verify full recovery and saved-state isolation. This is not physical GPU-loss injection.
limits: The controlled reproduction closely matches the reported shape but does not establish the physical Xbox root cause.
The fix rebuilds lost base/temporary blend surfaces and invalidates terrain chunks/viewport snapshots that may contain blank copies.
User-reported audio improvement is recorded, not independently certified by headless audio playback.
Loading/zoom stutters and the transient whole-screen blackout remain open; no new Xbox FPS or GPU-memory claim.
